author_or_account: Partnership for New York City; Michael Ostrovsky; Peter Harris
title: One Year of New York City Congestion Pricing
discussion_signal: Public posts frame congestion pricing as producing early traffic, commute, and transit-funding changes, while other discussion notes that effects vary by entry route and that early observations should not be treated as a complete evaluation of distributional or capital-delivery outcomes.
linked_research_question: How should early behavioral and transit changes be weighed against route-specific effects, capital delivery, and distributive legitimacy in evaluating congestion pricing?
limits: Posts mix advocacy, early observation, and research discussion
Early traffic effects are not the full policy evaluation
